name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
instructions: Rest your forearm on a bench, holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip, wrist hanging off.
Extend the wrist upward, lifting the dumbbell.
Lower slowly. Strengthens the wrist extensors.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the forearms. Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell) strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
